palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same forward and backward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization.

Here is an example of a palindrome that is at least 255 characters long:

"A man a plan a canal Panama" - The Panama Canal. A quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. "A man a plan a canal Panama" - The Panama Canal. A quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

This string contains 276 characters and is a palindrome when ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization.
